sloka: ततः पैतामहं वीरः सो ऽस्त्रमस्त्रविदां वरः ।सन्दधे सुमहातेजास्तं हरिप्रवरं प्रति ।। ५.४८.३७।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ paitāmahaṁ vīraḥ so 'stramastravidāṁ varaḥ ।sandadhe sumahātejāstaṁ haripravaraṁ prati ।। 5.48.37।।।।

translations.english: Indrajit, the strongarmed hero, who knew the secrets of all missiles, realising that the son of the Windgod cannot be killed caught him by the divine weapon of Brahma (Brahmastram).
